title: artanthe alnoides
intro: Artanthe alnoides, commonly known as the Indian licorice vine, is a flowering plant native to tropical regions of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, diarrhea, and skin disorders, due to its reported health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Artanthe alnoides include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and soothe skin irritations, making it a valuable herb in Ayurvedic medicine. The bioactive constituents of Artanthe alnoides include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
